Inspect the channels #daytona-support, #ddc-new-delhi, #feedback-and-ideas, #general, and #intro. For each channel, find up to the 5 most recent substantive top-level
    messages. Report the channel, author, Slack-displayed timestamp, concise topic, reply count, and reaction count. Finish with a comparison of which channels are most recently
    active and their main current topics. If fewer messages exist, report all available. Use only Slack-visible evidence. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any
    Slack content.
